In 2026/27, cold air alone is worth 1,535 MW of requirement relief on the auction’s scale and weatherization alone set to 100% is worth 3,143 MW, but together they are worth 3,320 MW, not 4,678. In the overlap winterization (when set to 100%) particularly dominates cold air’s effect, covering up to 76-96% depending on the year. At lower settings the overlap is reduced. For the annual settings we have chosen the overlap range becomes 53-69% depending on the year.The result of these improvements to the model inputs is that PJM has a more reliable fleet than its Reserve Requirement Study currently recognizes. So relative to modeled demand load it needed to procure less capacity than it has done for the last four years. In the two auctions where the price was free to move (2025/26 and 2026/27) that difference was worth $12B.Auction design is much harder to reform than modeling methodology. But you need to understand the design in order to see that relatively small shortfalls in modeled capacity can have outsized impacts on auction costs. PJM has two markets: one for energy which is in real time and one for capacity which is on an annual basis. A capacity contract pays a plant for being available, not for making energy. PJM interconnection queue is famously slow and long, but power plants applying joining the queue do so at their own risk, plants joining the capacity market are the ratepayers’ risk. Two costs matter in any power market: what it costs to run a plant for another hour, and what it cost to build and keep the plant at all. The first short-run marginal cost and the second long-run marginal cost. The daily energy market clears at the short-run marginal cost (fuel, labor, variable maintenance) of the last needed producer. This incentivizes bidding true cost rather than gaming the system as any more than that would risk not being dispatched and so earning nothing. The difference between the short-run and the long-run marginal cost (capital, assets, fixed maintenance) creates a “missing money” problem as power plants struggle to make this back in the daily energy market. Some electricity grids, most famously ERCOT in Texas, only have an energy market. Power plants make that missing money by putting prices really high when supply is scarce. But many markets use a capacity auction to provide this missing money, considering it the more stable approach. PJM’s annual capacity auction also pays all bidders the price of the last needed capacity.Every year PJM’s planning model (the Reserve Requirement Study, RRS) decides how much reliable power keeps shortfalls to one event in ten years (the 0.1 Loss of Load Expectation, LOLE). Because risks are spread out everyone in the market tries to free-ride on everyone else which means power capacity has no natural buyer. PJM acts as the insurance intermediary. It draws a market demand curve, a sliding schedule of what price it will pay at each level of supply (the Variable Resource Requirement, VRR). The yearly auction in which generation bids and PJM buys against that curve is the Base Residual Auction (BRA).Unfortunately, PJM runs one capacity auction that includes ~92-93% of fleet capacity, both existing generators and new generators. Most of the rest is covered by self-supplied utilities. This is a problem as these are substantially different products, new generators have much larger long-run marginal costs. Existing generators only need to cover their annual fixed costs, the Independent Market Monitor’s offer data shows most bids at $8-14/MW-day. New generators have substantial risk-related costs and much greater initial fixed costs. New and existing plants also receive the same one-year contract, even though a new plant normally needs a long-term contract with which to raise financing cost-effectively. This auction design means that if there is electricity demand growth which requires new plants to be built then prices will need to increase by a lot compared to the baseline. In PJM’s case the whole fleet’s price went from $28.92 to $270-333 per megawatt-day, roughly 20 to 40 times the $8-14 the existing plants themselves were offering. This creates huge windfalls to existing generators without necessarily increasing generation capacity on the system in an effective manner.Happy to be corrected, but we believe PJM is also unique in the world for how much of its fleet is put through the same marginal-priced auction. 93% of PJM capacity settles at the clearing price, against 15% in MISO’s residual auction, monthly rolling in New York, bilateral contracts in California, none in Texas, and New England just abandoned the design entirely. MISO also had a sharp auction price swing, but its auction is residual and utilities self-supply or contract for most capacity beforehand. Therefore about 86% of its 2025/26 summer requirement was met outside the auction, leaving most load protected against the swing. Great Britain, Ireland, Italy, and Japan run centralized auctions, but give qualifying new plants contracts of 10 or 20 years while existing plants generally receive one year.All of these markets make customers pay for growth. But the same growth in those markets would not drive the repricing of nearly the entire fleet as it did in PJM. That cost shift is a product of market design rather than inherent to load growth. Reform is coming, and datacenter developers have largely supported reforms to pay for capacity as it is in their interests for growth to happen painlessly. However, currently no proposals provide any respite for ratepayers who are still paying for design choices made two decades ago.This design is not without its reasons. For over 20 years, PJM has not experienced any load growth, and benefited from an early gas boom by Independent Power Producers that proved disastrous for early investors. Over that time less efficient plants have been pushed off the system by more efficient ones, in many ways a good system, just not one built for growth.For the four most recent auctions we have calculated what price and volume the auctions would have cleared at if the Reserve Requirement Study had been more accurate. That modeling improvement shifts the demand curve to the left. We find that the auctions for 2025/26 and for 2026/27 would have seen savings of $11.57 billion, with a sensitivity range between $8.0 billion and $14.5 billion combined while procuring more than the reliability requirement. The auctions for 2027/28 and 2028/29 would not have cleared at a lower price or volume because supply was tight enough that the price cap for those years still binds, even under improved modeling.The capacity auction price is set where the supply curve crosses PJM’s demand curve (VRR). The demand curve is a published price schedule stating what PJM will pay at each level of supply. The supply curve is made up of all the bids into the market; PJM and its market monitor publish the shape with key data points. We have reconstructed these curves for each of the four auctions.We then used our reverse-engineered Reserve Requirement Study to calculate how the curves move with improved inputs to incorporate cold air and asset winterization. Given the greater reliability of the existing fleet the need to procure a greater margin of supply over the electricity demand is reduced. This shifts the demand curve for capacity (VRR) to the left. We computed this by year given different inputs and concluded that for a 0.1 LOLE, whole-system reliable capacity requirements fall by: 2,879 MW (2025/26), 3,396 (2026/27), 4,513 (2027/28), 3,824 (2028/29). We have to assume that bids do not change as modeling bid behavior is complex, in reality there would be some change but we do not think it would be material in this context.PJM’s capacity market has a right-angled supply curve. The vast majority of it is low and flat, then some steady increase, before right at the end it spikes straight up. For example the 2025/26 auction had the first 79% of the bids between $2-5, the next 20% rose until they peaked at $105, and it was only the last 1% that went as high as $352, with the market clearing at $270. This is reflecting that most of the power plants in PJM have existed for a while and bid low as they have little difference between their short-run and long-run marginal costs. But then new power plants bid high to be able to afford to be built quickly and to cover their own risk. The shape of PJM’s supply curves is why, if you are at their limit, a small change in quantity demanded has a huge impact on price and on total cost, even when having a small impact on volume procured.The Base Residual Auctions do not stop at their required capacity, they clear on their demand curve. So if there is more capacity that can be bought at a price that PJM has decided is acceptable then it clears the auction. For the 2025/26 auction PJM’s ceiling price was $452 and enough bids came in that 135.7GW was procured for $270 against a required capacity of 133.6GW.If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 2.7GW. The adjusted target required capacity would have been 130.9GW and the auction would have cleared 135.7GW at a price of $135 (a 50% discount). Only 0.014GW difference, but that $135/MW-day saving is multiplied by the full 135.7GW (plus $270 times 0.014GW), then multiplied by 365 days to give $6.7B for the full auction.There is even a magnitude of impact sense check we can compare against. The independent market monitor ran a similar calculation in September 2024, for the cold-air credit alone. It found $2.7 billion with the reserve margin held fixed, and up to $8.0 billion without. Our figure also includes the reliability effects of winterization.The auction for 2026/27 included the first politically imposed price cap. PJM has price ceilings in its demand curve modeling but price caps were set as a hasty measure by governors to prevent PJM’s awkward auction design from harming ratepayers even more. While this was achieved, the price cap of $329 also prevented the auction from clearing properly. 134.2GW was procured against a required capacity of 134.5GW, only 0.3GW short. If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 3.1GW. The adjusted target required capacity would have been 131.4GW and the auction would have cleared 133.6GW at a price of $230. Only 0.6GW less, with an improved reliability margin, and $99/MW-day discount. Total auction savings of $4.9 billion.Price caps can have many unintended consequences. In this instance one result has been an emergency auction for 11-15 year contracts at elevated prices. Any generators that chose to withhold incremental capacity may well have benefited from doing so.2025/26 and 2026/27 are the two auctions in which we found PJM had wasted ratepayers’ money. The next two auctions would not have had price or volume impacts from improved modeling because supply was so constrained that even 4.5GW and 3.8GW of movement respectively would not get the demand curve to cross with the supply curve below the auctions’ political price caps.The 2027/28 auction held in December 2025, cleared at $333.44, at the price cap and 6.5GW short. So a 4.5GW leftwards shift in the demand curve is not sufficient to make a difference. The 2028/29 auction held in July 2026, cleared at $325.00, at the cap and 6.8GW short. The 6.8GW target falls to about 3GW with improved modeling.That 6.8GW vs 3GW is now the billions-of-dollars question for PJM’s fast-approaching emergency auction.Buying too much is bad in any auction, but this backstop auction has no defined counter-party. PJM plans to pay for power plants to get built on the expectation that energy demand arrives later. But if that demand does not arrive then PJM will still have to pay.In theory new large loads are supposed to pay for this emergency auction. But the forcasted large loads are hypothetical and won’t be signing on the dotted line. The plan is for PJM to sign the contracts and for the States to each pass their own cost-allocation policy to allocate costs onto participating new large loads. PJM’s filing clarifies that “Because PJM does not have jurisdiction to allocate retail costs directly to individual data centers, state action will be essential.” This creates a lot of uncertainty for large loads as cost pass-on will be bespoke state-by-state.Only new resources in service by June 2032 may bid. Contracts all end in 2043, so a power plant online in 2032 gets about eleven years. The costs are then assigned to transmission zones in proportion to forecast load growth between 2026/27 and 2028/29. Those shares are frozen for the full fifteen years. Inside each zone, a state will use bespoke policy design to direct the costs onward to specific large loads or distribution companies. If a state does nothing, the filing’s default applies and the costs fall on every load-serving entity in the zone by peak-load share.There is no true-up, the zone shares are set by forecast growth and never revisited. The supply contracts are structured as guaranteed top-ups. Each winner is made whole to its bid against whatever the capacity market later pays out to 2043. Load-serving entities assigned backstop costs must post credit support of $1.5 million per megawatt of obligation, within ninety days of each delivery year. At the ceiling average of $555/MW-day the maximum liability for 6.8GW is roughly $21 billion.There is no sweetener to encourage large loads to participate such as accelerated interconnection. There is not even assurance on ‘unaccelerated’ interconnection timelines. Then on the supply side there is little penalty for under-delivering once a plant is running. PJM itself projects that even with the backstop the next auction “may clear short”.Through PJM’s fast-track stakeholder process this spring, the members developed and endorsed a backstop design built around a voluntary subscription model. This was championed by a coalition of the electric distribution companies and the Data Center Coalition. The idea was for large new loads to subscribe first, committing to pay for the new capacity before it’s procured. Unbelievably for PJM that design won more than two-thirds sector-weighted support.Then the Board overrode its own members. In its decisional letter of 27th July 2026, the Board rejected the subscription framework on the stated ground that it “would not provide sufficient assurance that capacity equal to the identified near-term shortfall would actually be procured”.That is why improving this system modeling is crucial. The Board decided this high-risk emergency auction was necessary because of modeling which overstates the near-term shortfall. The near-term shortfall is currently 6.8GW, recomputed it would be 3.0GW, an amount a subscription model could plausibly have covered. The total requirement of 156GW is built from the 2028/29 load forecast, which already embeds the anticipated datacenter growth.PJM has filed the Board’s proposal at FERC on 31st July 2026. The Board’s design uses a $555 average-cap and they added back a badly designed curtailment scheme (IRAS) that the members had rightly voted down. Both of these measures seem designed to dissuade new large loads from joining this scheme.An average-price cap with pay-as-bid supply contracts means that participating demand loads do not know what price they will sign. The $555 cap constrains the portfolio average and not any individual contract. PJM’s own worked example shows a $600 offer clearing. The quantity being bought is also unknown, because the window for reporting bilateral offsets runs concurrently with the offer window. The load’s own share is unknown, because it depends on state allocation mechanisms that do not yet exist and on how many other loads participate. The average is applied at selection. If contracts are voided later, the remaining portfolio is never re-tested against $555. This risk is asymmetric on the upside as lower priced contracts are more likely to be abandoned or fail. Pay-as-bid makes this worse. In a marginal-price auction a bidder’s best strategy is to bid its true cost. Under pay-as-bid the best strategy is to bid your forecast of the highest accepted price. PJM’s own witness says this in the filing: pay-as-bid sellers “are more likely to offer the expected clearing price,” and market-power mitigation in this setting is “difficult and ineffective.”The Interim Resource Adequacy Service (IRAS) scheme applies to loads over 50MW after 2027/28 that are not covered by one of: the central procurement, self-supply, or a bilateral contract. These loads connect as non-firm and are curtailed first during capacity shortages, ahead of even the pre-emergency demand response programs. As an aside, non-firm connections are fair in extreme cases, but this is mad. Demand response participants are paid to curtail; it is a service they sell. The new large loads would be paying for this service in their electricity bills and still be turned off first. These demand loads will be in the hundreds of megawatts and are not designed for this kind of fast response or high-fidelity manipulation. It could even be dangerous to the system. PJM’s own staff had dropped mandatory curtailment days before the final stakeholder meeting, citing doubts about PJM’s jurisdiction to curtail retail load at all, and the generators’ own trade group warned that reviving it invited protracted litigation.For any load that can manage it, self-supply strictly dominates the auction. This will drive defection and greatly increase the risk of yet more over-procurement by PJM to the detriment of its rate-paying households and businesses. For the rest, greener pastures await in other power markets. Comments to FERC close 21st August at 17:00 Eastern. The auction runs from 30th September to 21st October, with results by 2nd December. This is only one week before the next regular auction opens on 9th December. PJM posted the class ratings for the 2029/30 auction on 7th August. Once again they were computed for endless summer. PJM will post the remaining parameters on 31st August. Everything in this piece is about decisions being made in the next ninety days.Other than our reverse-engineered model almost none of this is new. In 2023 PJM proposed a full two-season capacity market itself. But after the Independent Market Monitor and others objected that the design needed more development time, PJM withdrew it and filed an annual-only package; FERC approved that package in January 2024 and declined to require seasonality. In September 2024, the Independent Market Monitor concluded that crediting the winter capability of thermal plants would have cut that year’s capacity bill by $2.7 billion with the reserve margin held fixed, and up to $8.0 billion otherwise. Its standing recommendation read: “There is no reason that excess winter CIRs cannot be assigned to these resources immediately.” In May 2025 PJM’s sensitivity analysis found the fleet’s winter capability runs 8,561 megawatts above its summer ratings. That same month, members voted 3.699 (of 5 sector-weighted votes) to defer adjacent transmission work “until such time that stakeholders undertake work on a seasonal capacity construct.” In July 2025 PJM’s own task force endorsed the fix in Package C. This included winter ratings and passed 178 votes to 54, 77%. Twenty-six days later, on 20th August 2025, the senior committee killed it with 30.7% of the weighted vote. Generation owners argued a higher winter rating raises the benchmark a plant is penalized against when it underperforms in summer. The consumer sectors voted PJM’s package down while backing two blunter alternatives, and the generators killed those in turn. In December 2025 E3 recommended seasonal or daily ratings, Consideration 4 of 14. No vote has been held since.PJM’s centralized capacity market has fully failed at its core role of solving capacity shortfalls. Faced with the first instance of modest growth in its modern history, the capacity market was unable to procure capacity. Instead PJM’s design misallocated those dollars as windfall profits to existing generators while constraining supply with short lead times and long interconnection queues. PJM is making progress at creating a third energy market in the form of this emergency auction specifically for the new generation. But in doing so it is converting long-standing errors into long-standing liabilities with basic resource modeling accuracy still in the air.These specific modeling points have been debated before but without success in implementation. Our hope is that this effort to reverse-engineer and release PJM’s black box will move the debate through exposure to the size of impact this change in methodology could have. That is what we have attempted to do with the information that is publicly available. We must emphasize that there is key information which is not available which we have highlighted. This has the result that our modeling is at best a good approximation. If we are even half right, we need to change this modeling urgently to avoid further waste and create a clearer signal of what new capacity is required to enable PJM to grow once again.

blocks.html_en: Earlier this year, we explained why residents of the PJM area, America’s largest electricity market, have seen their power bills rise by ~20%. We argued that the main culprit was PJM’s auction design choices and how PJM models demand and supply. To better understand the extent of the problem, our Energy Model team spent the last 6 months reverse-engineering PJM’s main system model, the ‘Reserve Requirement Study’, which to date has been a black box. This study is how PJM decides what type of and how many power plants to buy to make sure electricity is reliable, using an annual auction, and spending billions each year.

blocks.html_en: PJM has constrained its own supply of new power by having one-year contracts that start too soon after they are signed, as well as being slow to connect these new plants to the grid. This means fulfilling any demand growth requires paying a big premium for new power plants to be built at unrealistic speeds. PJM also runs the only capacity market in the world that does not distinguish between new and existing power plants. So that premium paid for new power plants is also paid to existing power plants for doing nothing. The same growth in a market that splits new and existing power plant auctions avoids the volume effect of repricing the entire fleet; which means ratepayers are better protected from price spikes.

blocks.html_en: We also encourage PJM’s Board to file improved modeling criteria at FERC to change the tariff and Reliability Assurance Agreement, through the same fast-path process it used to install the current rules in 2023 and to launch the backstop this July. FERC must accept it if it is just and reasonable, and FERC accepted seasonal accreditation at MISO in 2022. The winter-ratings text was written in Package C in August 2025, passed by PJM’s own task force, but was not passed by the senior committee. The Board can pick it up tomorrow. Crediting mandated winterization has not been drafted. The closest attempt was the market monitor’s blunter version to delete the storm data outright, which was refused in the same session. FERC should require that the emergency auction’s 6.8GW target be recalculated before PJM signs contracts that will last until 2043.

blocks.html_en: For a primer on PJM’s capacity market and auctions, read our previous report. As a TLDR: PJM acts as a central planner and runs auctions to ensure there is enough supply to meet peak demand, with a safety buffer. PJM made its planning more sophisticated in 2024, but due to failed stakeholder votes, did not include important inputs. The result of leaving out these inputs is that PJM overestimates system risk during winter months which leads to trying to procure too many new power plants as backup. But PJM also has a constrained supply of new power plants which leads to price spikes, trying but failing to fix this scarcity.

blocks.html_en: In 2024, the same year the capacity auction prices first spiked, PJM overhauled their resource adequacy modeling. Previously, the PJM system operated under a system called “Equivalent Demand Forced Outage Rate” or EFORd. The capacity target was set by taking the peak demand and adding a margin based on the chance a generator might be offline. However, this system is not able to effectively capture correlated failures, which are more common in cold winter months for natural gas power plants. It also fails to account for newer technologies on the grid. Specifically variable resources which require modeling on at least an hourly basis to capture their contributions to capacity. These are intermittent generation such as wind, solar, or run-of-river hydro; as well as ‘limited’ resources, like storage of all kinds.

sentences.en: It also fails to account for newer technologies on the grid.

sentences.zh: 特别是可变资源，需要至少每小时建模以捕获其对容量的贡献。

sentences.en: These are intermittent generation such as wind, solar, or run-of-river hydro; as well as ‘limited’ resources, like storage of all kinds.
sentences.zh: 这些是间歇性发电，例如风能、太阳能或径流水力发电；以及“有限”资源，例如各种存储。

blocks.html_en: These limitations came to light in 2022. During Winter Storm Elliott, PJM lost 24% of its total generation due to forced outages and derates, and two thirds of the loss came from natural gas generators. Storm Elliott led to a substantial overhaul of the Reserve Requirement Study making it into an hourly risk framework. In this study PJM models demand against supply for every hour of the year for a number of theoretical years, using both historic and forecast-based randomized data. This more detailed approach identified that at certain times of the year there is not enough supply relative to demand.

blocks.html_en: The shift from a summer risk system to a winter risk system is a much bigger deal in PJM. It has one central auction, versus other capacity markets, which instead distinguish specifically between winter and summer. For PJM, a winter risk system degrades the reliability value of stronger summer resources (e.g. solar and storage which can bridge afternoon peaks), and enhances the stronger winter resources (e.g. nuclear, coal). Even a minor improvement in winter gas risk can have ripple effects across every resource, with major commercial implications.

sentences.en: The shift from a summer risk system to a winter risk system is a much bigger deal in PJM.

Our model re-runs the Reserve Requirement Study on the same whole-system basis PJM uses. Our conclusion is that the same fleet is worth more reliable capacity than PJM credits it, so the auction requirement against total electricity demand falls.

sentences.en: PJM’s new(ish) system overestimates the risk in winter months which leads to overbuilding power plants.
sentences.zh: PJM 的新系统高估了冬季的风险，导致发电厂过度建设。

sentences.en: Our model re-runs the Reserve Requirement Study on the same whole-system basis PJM uses.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型在 PJM 使用的相同全系统基础上重新运行储备金要求研究。

sentences.en: Our conclusion is that the same fleet is worth more reliable capacity than PJM credits it, so the auction requirement against total electricity demand falls.
sentences.zh: 我们的结论是，相同的机队比 PJM 所认为的更可靠的容量值得，因此针对总电力需求的拍卖要求下降。

blocks.html_en: While PJM models demand with its year-round variations, it caps supply at generators’ summer accreditations. On one hand, that makes sense as PJM is a summer peaking system. There is more air conditioning electricity demand in the summer than there is heating demand in the winter, and so the highest demand points in the year are in summer. Even when netted off against the increased output of solar, the demand for reliable power plants is still higher in the summer than it is in the winter.

sentences.en: While PJM models demand with its year-round variations, it caps supply at generators’ summer accreditations.
sentences.zh: 虽然 PJM 会根据全年变化对需求进行建模，但它会在发电机夏季认证时限制供应。

sentences.en: On one hand, that makes sense as PJM is a summer peaking system.

sentences.en: There is more air conditioning electricity demand in the summer than there is heating demand in the winter, and so the highest demand points in the year are in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏季空调用电需求大于冬季供暖需求，因此全年最高需求点在夏季。

sentences.en: Even when netted off against the increased output of solar, the demand for reliable power plants is still higher in the summer than it is in the winter.
sentences.zh: 即使扣除太阳能发电量增加的影响，夏季对可靠发电厂的需求仍然高于冬季。

blocks.html_en: On the other hand, historically failure rates of generation are much higher in the winter, tend to be correlated across fleets, and aligned with periods of highest demand. Higher failure rates mean that winter can be the most probable time for supply to fall short of demand. Gas is less reliable in winter as storms can cause them all to freeze at the same time, as seen with the Polar Vortex and Storm Elliott.

sentences.en: On the other hand, historically failure rates of generation are much higher in the winter, tend to be correlated across fleets, and aligned with periods of highest demand.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，从历史上看，冬季的发电故障率要高得多，往往与机组之间相关，并且与最高需求时期一致。

sentences.en: Higher failure rates mean that winter can be the most probable time for supply to fall short of demand.
sentences.zh: 较高的故障率意味着冬季最有可能出现供应不足的情况。

sentences.en: Gas is less reliable in winter as storms can cause them all to freeze at the same time, as seen with the Polar Vortex and Storm Elliott.
sentences.zh: 天然气在冬季不太可靠，因为风暴可能会导致它们同时结冰，正如极地涡旋和埃利奥特风暴所见。

blocks.html_en: This type of winter risk is recognized in PJM’s modeling but the details are out of date and lack precision. They do not consider how cold improves the operations of the plants that do not fail, or how plants have hardened themselves against the weather in recent years.

sentences.en: This type of winter risk is recognized in PJM’s modeling but the details are out of date and lack precision.
sentences.zh: PJM 的模型认识到了这种类型的冬季风险，但细节已经过时且缺乏精确性。

sentences.en: They do not consider how cold improves the operations of the plants that do not fail, or how plants have hardened themselves against the weather in recent years.
sentences.zh: 他们没有考虑寒冷如何改善那些不会发生故障的工厂的运行，或者近年来植物如何抵御天气的影响。

blocks.html_en: PJM uses historical data for performance. This means that if a resource falters one time, the only way to increase reliability is to wait over a decade to flush the event out of the system. No amount of investments, regulations, or assurances can lift this judgment. As a result, the largest driver of reliability risk to this day was driven by a polar vortex in 2013 and the second is Storm Elliott in 2022.

sentences.en: PJM uses historical data for performance.
sentences.zh: PJM 使用历史数据来衡量绩效。

sentences.en: This means that if a resource falters one time, the only way to increase reliability is to wait over a decade to flush the event out of the system.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，如果某个资源出现故障一次，提高可靠性的唯一方法就是等待十多年才能将该事件从系统中清除。

sentences.en: No amount of investments, regulations, or assurances can lift this judgment.
sentences.zh: 无论有多少投资、监管或保证都无法推翻这一判断。

sentences.en: As a result, the largest driver of reliability risk to this day was driven by a polar vortex in 2013 and the second is Storm Elliott in 2022.
sentences.zh: 因此，迄今为止，可靠性风险的最大驱动因素是 2013 年的极地涡旋，其次是 2022 年的艾略特风暴。

blocks.html_en: Why aren’t PJM ratepayers better protected from price swings? In most other power markets, retail customers have long-term contracts with utilities and are not exposed to yearly capacity market changes. The market next door, MISO, also experienced substantial capacity swings, but the vast majority of households were unaffected because utilities had long-term contracts.

sentences.en: Why aren’t PJM ratepayers better protected from price swings?
sentences.zh: 为什么 PJM 纳税人没有更好地免受价格波动的影响？

sentences.en: In most other power markets, retail customers have long-term contracts with utilities and are not exposed to yearly capacity market changes.
sentences.zh: 在大多数其他电力市场中，零售客户与公用事业公司签订了长期合同，并且不受年度容量市场变化的影响。

sentences.en: The market next door, MISO, also experienced substantial capacity swings, but the vast majority of households were unaffected because utilities had long-term contracts.
sentences.zh: 隔壁的市场 MISO 也经历了大幅的容量波动，但绝大多数家庭没有受到影响，因为公用事业公司签订了长期合同。

blocks.html_en: There are a number of reasons PJM is so all-or-nothing, but it comes down to a combination of retail choice and deregulation (shorter and less certain contracts), a Supreme Court case that struck down state efforts to support long-term contracts, and a long-standing FERC fight that boiled down to a partisan battle between resource preferences.

sentences.en: There are a number of reasons PJM is so all-or-nothing, but it comes down to a combination of retail choice and deregulation (shorter and less certain contracts), a Supreme Court case that struck down state efforts to support long-term contracts, and a long-standing FERC fight that boiled down to a partisan battle between resource preferences.
sentences.zh: PJM 如此全有或全无的原因有很多，但归根结底是零售选择和放松管制（合同期限较短且确定性较低）、最高法院的一个案例推翻了各州支持长期合同的努力，以及 FERC 的长期斗争，最终归结为资源偏好之间的党派之争。

blocks.html_en: The other main option remaining is for utilities to procure enough capacity for themselves and then effectively eject themselves fully from the capacity market for 5 years. This shows up on the capacity markets as big swings, but ends up being relatively neutral impacts because the supply and demand impact is balanced.

sentences.en: The other main option remaining is for utilities to procure enough capacity for themselves and then effectively eject themselves fully from the capacity market for 5 years.
sentences.zh: 剩下的另一个主要选择是公用事业公司为自己采购足够的容量，然后在 5 年内有效地将自己完全退出容量市场。

sentences.en: This shows up on the capacity markets as big swings, but ends up being relatively neutral impacts because the supply and demand impact is balanced.
sentences.zh: 这在容量市场上表现为大幅波动，但最终影响相对中性，因为供需影响是平衡的。

blocks.html_en: While data for PJM’s overall fleet is relatively transparent and drives their risk model, the auction itself diverges in often unpredictable ways and cannot be fully replicated.

sentences.en: While data for PJM’s overall fleet is relatively transparent and drives their risk model, the auction itself diverges in often unpredictable ways and cannot be fully replicated.
sentences.zh: 虽然 PJM 整个机队的数据相对透明并驱动其风险模型，但拍卖本身往往以不可预测的方式出现分歧，并且无法完全复制。

blocks.html_en: The Reserve Requirement Study is bigger than just the Base Residual Auction, as some utilities ‘self-supply’. The Fixed Resource Requirement (FRR) alternative allows utilities to opt out of the auction and file their own capacity plans, with an obligation set by their share of load, which is ~8% of the PJM system (e.g. 12GW for 2026/27).

sentences.en: The Reserve Requirement Study is bigger than just the Base Residual Auction, as some utilities ‘self-supply’.
sentences.zh: 储备金要求研究的范围不仅仅是基本剩余拍卖，因为一些公用事业公司是“自我供应”的。

sentences.en: The Fixed Resource Requirement (FRR) alternative allows utilities to opt out of the auction and file their own capacity plans, with an obligation set by their share of load, which is ~8% of the PJM system (e.g. 12GW for 2026/27).
sentences.zh: 固定资源需求 (FRR) 替代方案允许公用事业公司选择退出拍卖并提交自己的容量计划，并根据其负载份额设定义务，负载份额约为 PJM 系统的 8%（例如 2026/27 年为 12GW）。

blocks.html_en: So PJM’s Reserve Requirement Study models an ‘Assumed Fleet’, and produces a whole-system number (e.g. 146GW of reliable capacity for 2026/27). The auction’s target is the requirement minus the self-supply obligation (e.g. 134GW for 2026/27).

blocks.html_en: The ‘Committed Fleet’ is the result of the auction and self-supply. In 2026/27 the auction cleared 134.3GW, 0.2GW short of its target, while the self-supply plans committed 12GW, about 0.3GW more than their obligation. The system ended the auction 0.1GW above the whole-system requirement, but only because self-supply over-delivered by more than the auction missed. Behind all of this sits the total fleet, the power plants that physically exist.

blocks.html_en: To get the real numbers we needed to rebuild the model in full. So we took PJM’s Manual, which explains how they do this study and turned it into code. Then we ran on that code the weather, demand, and generation data that they publish. For data that they do not give we used publicly available proxies, mainly from the U.S. Energy Information Administration. We got a high level of accuracy to the outputs that PJM publishes across the last four auctions. The detailed step by step is included in the Methodology Annex of this newsletter to help subscribers who wishes to recreate or audit our work.

blocks.html_en: We calculated this by using our reconstructed Reserve Requirement Study to test how much the outputs would change if we altered two input assumptions that have been widely debated and previously proposed: crediting cold air uplift and asset winterization. Again, the detailed steps are in the Methodology Annex.

blocks.html_en: A turbine is a mass-flow machine, cold air is denser, so turbines can squeeze more electricity out when temperatures drop. If you ignore ways that a system is more efficient in winter, but still recognize winter failure risk then you double count the risk and buy too many power plants.

sentences.en: A turbine is a mass-flow machine, cold air is denser, so turbines can squeeze more electricity out when temperatures drop.
sentences.zh: 涡轮机是一种大流量机器，冷空气密度更大，因此当温度下降时涡轮机可以挤出更多电力。

sentences.en: If you ignore ways that a system is more efficient in winter, but still recognize winter failure risk then you double count the risk and buy too many power plants.
sentences.zh: 如果您忽略系统在冬季提高效率的方法，但仍然认识到冬季故障风险，那么您就会重复计算风险并购买太多发电厂。

blocks.html_en: PJM’s modeling does not recognize that cold weather makes thermal plants more efficient, and increases the available capacity on the grid during cold periods. Cold temperatures make the air denser and improve temperature gradients, which improves turbine flow and increases the peak electricity output of a unit. For combustion turbines, this impact is as high as 25%, and PJM’s class table averages 8.4% for turbines over the winter months. While gas plants are more likely to come offline in the winter, their fellow gas plants are better able to produce more power to make up for it. Steam plants also benefit from colder cooling water which lowers condenser pressure, improving cycle efficiency. Instead these plants are modeled as if it were the summer months.

sentences.en: PJM’s modeling does not recognize that cold weather makes thermal plants more efficient, and increases the available capacity on the grid during cold periods.
sentences.zh: PJM 的模型并未认识到寒冷天气会使火力发电厂更加高效，并会增加寒冷时期电网的可用容量。

sentences.zh: 对于燃气轮机来说，这种影响高达 25%，PJM 的等级表在冬季对涡轮机的平均影响为 8.4%。

sentences.en: While gas plants are more likely to come offline in the winter, their fellow gas plants are better able to produce more power to make up for it.
sentences.zh: 虽然天然气发电厂更有可能在冬季停产，但其他天然气发电厂能够更好地生产更多电力来弥补这一损失。

sentences.en: Steam plants also benefit from colder cooling water which lowers condenser pressure, improving cycle efficiency.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽设备还受益于较冷的冷却水，降低了冷凝器压力，提高了循环效率。

sentences.en: Instead these plants are modeled as if it were the summer months.
sentences.zh: 相反，这些植物被建模为夏季。

blocks.html_en: Crediting cold air counterbalances the greater breakdown risk. Our model runs these two dynamics side-by-side hour-by-hour. It keeps PJM’s winter breakdown rates exactly as PJM sets them, and credits extra output per thermal plant running in each simulated hour. Netted over 41,600 simulated years, crediting cold air alone, with PJM’s failure rates untouched, still cuts the capacity requirement by 1.3 to 2.2GW depending on the year.

sentences.zh: 归功于冷空气可以抵消更大的故障风险。

sentences.en: Our model runs these two dynamics side-by-side hour-by-hour.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型每小时并排运行这两种动态。

sentences.en: It keeps PJM’s winter breakdown rates exactly as PJM sets them, and credits extra output per thermal plant running in each simulated hour.
sentences.zh: 它使 PJM 的冬季故障率与 PJM 的设定完全相同，并在每个模拟小时内将每个热电厂运行的额外产量记入其中。

sentences.en: Netted over 41,600 simulated years, crediting cold air alone, with PJM’s failure rates untouched, still cuts the capacity requirement by 1.3 to 2.2GW depending on the year.
sentences.zh: 经过 41,600 多年的模拟，仅考虑冷空气，在 PJM 的故障率不变的情况下，容量需求仍会根据年份减少 1.3 至 2.2GW。

blocks.html_en: PJM was already told they were modeling this wrong. E3, the consultant PJM hired to review its methodology, highlighted the bias in its December 2025 evaluation: “PJM asymmetrically applies ambient derates to the ICAP of unlimited resource classes when temperatures rise but does not apply ambient uprates when temperatures fall.” PJM’s own May 2025 sensitivity tested crediting it in the model which resulted in 33 percent less winter loss of load hours and a 1.1 percentage point lower reserve margin against the 2026/27 auction model. E3’s consideration 4 of 14 was to adopt seasonal or daily capability ratings.

sentences.en: PJM was already told they were modeling this wrong.
sentences.zh: PJM 已经被告知他们的建模是错误的。

sentences.zh: E3 考虑的 14 项中的第 4 项是采用季节性或每日能力评级。

blocks.html_en: PJM measured winter capability uplift as 8.5GW nameplate. Despite this massive impact (worth at least $13B in new gas plants at a conservative $1500/kW), PJM did not implement this adjustment despite having all the core information. One of the primary reasons is that they would have to run deliverability studies to determine if the additional capacity could serve the whole system. To our knowledge, PJM never ran these studies. It is worth noting that the likelihood of deliverability is high. In stressed circumstances, a large portion of the otherwise deliverable fleet would be offline, and the cold also improves the thermal capacity of all grid components (including conductors, substations, and breakers). Using the summertime capacity ratings for wintertime thermal production is physically inaccurate, but due to stakeholder disagreement (detailed in Package C of the ELCC taskforce), proposed reforms to implement this basic change did not pass.

blocks.html_en: PJM does not properly credit power plants that invest in hardening themselves against extreme events. This means it underestimated winter risk before Storm Elliott and could now overestimate the risk of their newly winterized fleet. This lack of accuracy and forecasting drives up the cost of electricity. Crediting weatherization alone for the 2026/27 auction would have been worth up to 3GW of reliable power.

sentences.en: PJM does not properly credit power plants that invest in hardening themselves against extreme events.
sentences.zh: PJM 并没有正确地信任那些投资加强自身抵御极端事件的发电厂。

sentences.en: This means it underestimated winter risk before Storm Elliott and could now overestimate the risk of their newly winterized fleet.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它在艾略特风暴之前低估了冬季风险，现在可能高估了新过冬船队的风险。

sentences.en: This lack of accuracy and forecasting drives up the cost of electricity.
sentences.zh: 缺乏准确性和预测会推高电力成本。

sentences.en: Crediting weatherization alone for the 2026/27 auction would have been worth up to 3GW of reliable power.
sentences.zh: 仅考虑到 2026/27 年拍卖的耐候性，可靠电力的价值就高达 3GW。

blocks.html_en: Crediting winterization and other forms of resilience investment would be a strong financial incentive for plants to invest as they would then earn more in capacity auctions. Instead PJM establishes plant failure rates based on past performance, and the large collapses of the gas fleet during the Polar Vortex and more recently during Winter Storm Elliott play an outsized role in reducing the capacity value which PJM credits to gas plants. For increased statistical heft PJM uses as many historical weather years as possible. But once there is a big miss only time and good performance can slowly return this to baseline. A painstaking process of asymptotic averages. Even if gas plants invested billions in weatherization or demonstrated extraordinary resilience during a similar event.

sentences.en: Crediting winterization and other forms of resilience investment would be a strong financial incentive for plants to invest as they would then earn more in capacity auctions.
sentences.zh: 归功于防冻和其他形式的弹性投资，将成为工厂投资的强大财务激励，因为它们将在产能拍卖中获得更多收益。

sentences.zh: 渐近平均的艰苦过程。

sentences.zh: 即使天然气厂投资了数十亿美元用于防风雨或在类似事件中表现出非凡的恢复能力。

blocks.html_en: Plants fail because components freeze: instrumentation and sensing lines, valves, fuel handling. During Winter Storm Elliott (December 2022), PJM saw 46GW of coincident outages. The FERC/NERC joint inquiry (October 2023) found that at least 75% of freezing-caused failures occurred at temperatures above the units’ documented operating limits. Which means a properly winterized unit would not have failed.

sentences.en: Plants fail because components freeze: instrumentation and sensing lines, valves, fuel handling.
sentences.zh: 工厂因部件冻结而发生故障：仪表和传感线路、阀门、燃料处理。

sentences.en: During Winter Storm Elliott (December 2022), PJM saw 46GW of coincident outages.
sentences.zh: 在冬季风暴埃利奥特（2022 年 12 月）期间，PJM 发生了 46GW 的同时停电。

sentences.en: The FERC/NERC joint inquiry (October 2023) found that at least 75% of freezing-caused failures occurred at temperatures above the units’ documented operating limits.
sentences.zh: FERC/NERC 联合调查（2023 年 10 月）发现，至少 75% 的冻结引起的故障发生在温度高于机组记录的运行限制的情况下。

sentences.en: Which means a properly winterized unit would not have failed.
sentences.zh: 这意味着适当防冻的装置不会出现故障。

blocks.html_en: By the winter beginning November 2025, the existing fleet was winterized substantially more than PJM’s model assumes. Mandatory cold-weather preparedness plans, annual training for every unit, and reporting of each unit’s cold-weather operating limits were mandated by April 2023. By January 2024, more than 400 generators had reported winterization improvements to PJM, a figure PJM published in its own review of Storm Gerri. PJM has roughly 450 gas units and about 750 thermal units in total, so that is the majority of the relevant units. The reports are self-made but they were filed under a regime that already required every unit to hold a cold-weather plan, and they came nearly two years before the auction’s winter we are modeling. A legally required calculation of every unit’s extreme cold weather temperature was due by October 2024. The event-CAP rule was enforceable from October 2024; any unit that froze during winter 2024/25 owed a completed corrective plan before December 2025. In addition, binding NERC winterization standards ramp through 2027, although this had no impact on recent auctions that target years after it goes into effect.

sentences.en: By the winter beginning November 2025, the existing fleet was winterized substantially more than PJM’s model assumes.
sentences.zh: 到 2025 年 11 月开始的冬季，现有机队的防冻程度大大超过 PJM 模型假设的程度。

sentences.zh: 截至 2024 年 1 月，已有 400 多台发电机向 PJM 报告了防冻改进措施，这一数字 PJM 在自己的 Storm Gerri 评论中发表。

blocks.html_en: There is evidence of winterization in the fleet’s recent performance. Gerri (January 2024) had a peak of 16GW or 9% in forced outages against Elliott’s 46GW. The MLK storm (January 2025) also had a 9% forced-outage rate against Elliott’s 24%, on similar weather over a holiday weekend, while serving an all-time winter peak. Storm Fern (January 2026) had outages of 18-19GW or 10%. During each of the cold events since Storm Elliott, PJM’s fleet has behaved like one substantially winterized. MLK in January 2025 with Elliott-like weather showed no excess clustering at all.

sentences.en: Storm Fern (January 2026) had outages of 18-19GW or 10%.

blocks.html_en: Two costs matter in any power market: what it costs to run a plant for another hour, and what it cost to build and keep the plant at all. The first short-run marginal cost and the second long-run marginal cost. The daily energy market clears at the short-run marginal cost (fuel, labor, variable maintenance) of the last needed producer. This incentivizes bidding true cost rather than gaming the system as any more than that would risk not being dispatched and so earning nothing. The difference between the short-run and the long-run marginal cost (capital, assets, fixed maintenance) creates a “missing money” problem as power plants struggle to make this back in the daily energy market. Some electricity grids, most famously ERCOT in Texas, only have an energy market. Power plants make that missing money by putting prices really high when supply is scarce. But many markets use a capacity auction to provide this missing money, considering it the more stable approach. PJM’s annual capacity auction also pays all bidders the price of the last needed capacity.

blocks.html_en: Every year PJM’s planning model (the Reserve Requirement Study, RRS) decides how much reliable power keeps shortfalls to one event in ten years (the 0.1 Loss of Load Expectation, LOLE). Because risks are spread out everyone in the market tries to free-ride on everyone else which means power capacity has no natural buyer. PJM acts as the insurance intermediary. It draws a market demand curve, a sliding schedule of what price it will pay at each level of supply (the Variable Resource Requirement, VRR). The yearly auction in which generation bids and PJM buys against that curve is the Base Residual Auction (BRA).

blocks.html_en: Unfortunately, PJM runs one capacity auction that includes ~92-93% of fleet capacity, both existing generators and new generators. Most of the rest is covered by self-supplied utilities. This is a problem as these are substantially different products, new generators have much larger long-run marginal costs. Existing generators only need to cover their annual fixed costs, the Independent Market Monitor’s offer data shows most bids at $8-14/MW-day. New generators have substantial risk-related costs and much greater initial fixed costs. New and existing plants also receive the same one-year contract, even though a new plant normally needs a long-term contract with which to raise financing cost-effectively. This auction design means that if there is electricity demand growth which requires new plants to be built then prices will need to increase by a lot compared to the baseline. In PJM’s case the whole fleet’s price went from $28.92 to $270-333 per megawatt-day, roughly 20 to 40 times the $8-14 the existing plants themselves were offering. This creates huge windfalls to existing generators without necessarily increasing generation capacity on the system in an effective manner.

blocks.html_en: Happy to be corrected, but we believe PJM is also unique in the world for how much of its fleet is put through the same marginal-priced auction. 93% of PJM capacity settles at the clearing price, against 15% in MISO’s residual auction, monthly rolling in New York, bilateral contracts in California, none in Texas, and New England just abandoned the design entirely. We have to assume that bids do not change as modeling bid behavior is complex, in reality there would be some change but we do not think it would be material in this context.
sentences.zh: 我们必须假设出价不会改变，因为建模出价行为很复杂，实际上会发生一些变化，但我们认为在这种情况下这不会是实质性的。

blocks.html_en: PJM’s capacity market has a right-angled supply curve. The vast majority of it is low and flat, then some steady increase, before right at the end it spikes straight up. For example the 2025/26 auction had the first 79% of the bids between $2-5, the next 20% rose until they peaked at $105, and it was only the last 1% that went as high as $352, with the market clearing at $270. This is reflecting that most of the power plants in PJM have existed for a while and bid low as they have little difference between their short-run and long-run marginal costs. But then new power plants bid high to be able to afford to be built quickly and to cover their own risk. The shape of PJM’s supply curves is why, if you are at their limit, a small change in quantity demanded has a huge impact on price and on total cost, even when having a small impact on volume procured.

sentences.en: PJM’s capacity market has a right-angled supply curve.
sentences.zh: PJM 的容量市场具有直角供给曲线。

sentences.en: The vast majority of it is low and flat, then some steady increase, before right at the end it spikes straight up.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数是低而平坦的，然后一些稳定增长，最后直接上升。

sentences.en: For example the 2025/26 auction had the first 79% of the bids between $2-5, the next 20% rose until they peaked at $105, and it was only the last 1% that went as high as $352, with the market clearing at $270.
sentences.zh: 例如，2025/26 年的拍卖中，前 79% 的出价在 2-5 美元之间，接下来的 20% 上涨，直到达到峰值 105 美元，只有最后 1% 的出价高达 352 美元，市场出清价为 270 美元。

sentences.en: This is reflecting that most of the power plants in PJM have existed for a while and bid low as they have little difference between their short-run and long-run marginal costs.
sentences.zh: 这反映出 PJM 的大多数发电厂已经存在了一段时间并且出价较低，因为它们的短期和长期边际成本差异不大。

sentences.en: But then new power plants bid high to be able to afford to be built quickly and to cover their own risk.
sentences.zh: 但后来新发电厂的出价很高，以便能够快速建设并承担自身风险。

sentences.en: The shape of PJM’s supply curves is why, if you are at their limit, a small change in quantity demanded has a huge impact on price and on total cost, even when having a small impact on volume procured.
sentences.zh: PJM 供给曲线的形状解释了为什么，如果达到极限，需求数量的微小变化会对价格和总成本产生巨大影响，即使对采购量影响很小。

blocks.html_en: The Base Residual Auctions do not stop at their required capacity, they clear on their demand curve. So if there is more capacity that can be bought at a price that PJM has decided is acceptable then it clears the auction. For the 2025/26 auction PJM’s ceiling price was $452 and enough bids came in that 135.7GW was procured for $270 against a required capacity of 133.6GW.

sentences.en: The Base Residual Auctions do not stop at their required capacity, they clear on their demand curve.
sentences.zh: 基本剩余拍卖不会在其所需容量时停止，而是在其需求曲线上进行清理。

sentences.en: So if there is more capacity that can be bought at a price that PJM has decided is acceptable then it clears the auction.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果可以以 PJM 认为可以接受的价格购买更多容量，那么它就会清除拍卖。

sentences.en: For the 2025/26 auction PJM’s ceiling price was $452 and enough bids came in that 135.7GW was procured for $270 against a required capacity of 133.6GW.
sentences.zh: 对于 2025/26 年拍卖，PJM 的上限价格为 452 美元，并且有足够的出价，以 270 美元的价格采购了 135.7GW，而所需容量为 133.6GW。

blocks.html_en: If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 2.7GW. The adjusted target required capacity would have been 130.9GW and the auction would have cleared 135.7GW at a price of $135 (a 50% discount). Only 0.014GW difference, but that $135/MW-day saving is multiplied by the full 135.7GW (plus $270 times 0.014GW), then multiplied by 365 days to give $6.7B for the full auction.

sentences.en: If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 2.7GW.
sentences.zh: 如果储备金要求研究的计算方式不同，那么需求曲线将向左移动 2.7GW。

sentences.en: The adjusted target required capacity would have been 130.9GW and the auction would have cleared 135.7GW at a price of $135 (a 50% discount).
sentences.zh: 调整后的目标需求容量将为 130.9GW，拍卖将以 135 美元的价格（50% 折扣）清算 135.7GW。

sentences.en: Only 0.014GW difference, but that $135/MW-day saving is multiplied by the full 135.7GW (plus $270 times 0.014GW), then multiplied by 365 days to give $6.7B for the full auction.
sentences.zh: 只有 0.014GW 的差异，但是 $135/MW-day 的节省乘以全部 135.7GW（再加上 $270 乘以 0.014GW），然后乘以 365 天，得到全部拍卖的 $6.7B。

blocks.html_en: There is even a magnitude of impact sense check we can compare against. The independent market monitor ran a similar calculation in September 2024, for the cold-air credit alone. It found $2.7 billion with the reserve margin held fixed, and up to $8.0 billion without. Our figure also includes the reliability effects of winterization.

sentences.en: There is even a magnitude of impact sense check we can compare against.
sentences.zh: 甚至我们还可以进行一定程度的冲击感检查来进行比较。

sentences.en: The independent market monitor ran a similar calculation in September 2024, for the cold-air credit alone.
sentences.zh: 独立市场监测机构于 2024 年 9 月对冷空气信贷进行了类似的计算。

sentences.en: It found $2.7 billion with the reserve margin held fixed, and up to $8.0 billion without.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，有 27 亿美元的准备金保证金保持固定，最多 80 亿美元没有准备金保证金。

sentences.en: Our figure also includes the reliability effects of winterization.
sentences.zh: 我们的数据还包括防冻措施对可靠性的影响。

blocks.html_en: The auction for 2026/27 included the first politically imposed price cap. PJM has price ceilings in its demand curve modeling but price caps were set as a hasty measure by governors to prevent PJM’s awkward auction design from harming ratepayers even more. While this was achieved, the price cap of $329 also prevented the auction from clearing properly. 134.2GW was procured against a required capacity of 134.5GW, only 0.3GW short.

sentences.en: The auction for 2026/27 included the first politically imposed price cap.
sentences.zh: 2026/27 年的拍卖包括第一个政治强制的价格上限。

sentences.en: PJM has price ceilings in its demand curve modeling but price caps were set as a hasty measure by governors to prevent PJM’s awkward auction design from harming ratepayers even more.
sentences.zh: PJM 在其需求曲线模型中设定了价格上限，但价格上限是州长们仓促采取的措施，目的是防止 PJM 笨拙的拍卖设计进一步伤害纳税人。

sentences.en: While this was achieved, the price cap of $329 also prevented the auction from clearing properly.
sentences.zh: 虽然实现了这一目标，但 329 美元的价格上限也阻碍了拍卖的正常清算。

sentences.en: 134.2GW was procured against a required capacity of 134.5GW, only 0.3GW short.
sentences.zh: 采购量为134.2GW，而所需产能为134.5GW，仅缺口0.3GW。

blocks.html_en: If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 3.1GW. The adjusted target required capacity would have been 131.4GW and the auction would have cleared 133.6GW at a price of $230. Only 0.6GW less, with an improved reliability margin, and $99/MW-day discount. Total auction savings of $4.9 billion.

sentences.en: If the Reserve Requirement Study had been computed differently then the demand curve would have been shifted to the left by 3.1GW.
sentences.zh: 如果储备金要求研究的计算方式不同，那么需求曲线将向左移动 3.1GW。

sentences.en: The adjusted target required capacity would have been 131.4GW and the auction would have cleared 133.6GW at a price of $230.
sentences.zh: 调整后的目标需求容量将为 131.4GW，拍卖将以 230 美元的价格清算 133.6GW。

sentences.en: Only 0.6GW less, with an improved reliability margin, and $99/MW-day discount.
sentences.zh: 仅减少 0.6GW，可靠性裕度提高，并且每兆瓦日折扣为 99 美元。

sentences.en: Total auction savings of $4.9 billion.
sentences.zh: 拍卖总计节省 49 亿美元。

blocks.html_en: Price caps can have many unintended consequences. In this instance one result has been an emergency auction for 11-15 year contracts at elevated prices. Any generators that chose to withhold incremental capacity may well have benefited from doing so.

sentences.en: Price caps can have many unintended consequences.
sentences.zh: 价格上限可能会产生许多意想不到的后果。

sentences.en: In this instance one result has been an emergency auction for 11-15 year contracts at elevated prices.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，结果之一是以高价紧急拍卖 11-15 年期合同。

sentences.en: Any generators that chose to withhold incremental capacity may well have benefited from doing so.
sentences.zh: 任何选择保留增量容量的发电商很可能会从中受益。

blocks.html_en: 2025/26 and 2026/27 are the two auctions in which we found PJM had wasted ratepayers’ money. The next two auctions would not have had price or volume impacts from improved modeling because supply was so constrained that even 4.5GW and 3.8GW of movement respectively would not get the demand curve to cross with the supply curve below the auctions’ political price caps.

sentences.en: 2025/26 and 2026/27 are the two auctions in which we found PJM had wasted ratepayers’ money.
sentences.zh: 我们发现 PJM 在 2025/26 和 2026/27 两次拍卖中浪费了纳税人的钱。

sentences.en: The next two auctions would not have had price or volume impacts from improved modeling because supply was so constrained that even 4.5GW and 3.8GW of movement respectively would not get the demand curve to cross with the supply curve below the auctions’ political price caps.
sentences.zh: 接下来的两次拍卖不会因改进模型而对价格或数量产生影响，因为供应非常有限，即使分别有 4.5GW 和 3.8GW 的流动量也不会让需求曲线与低于拍卖政治价格上限的供应曲线交叉。

blocks.html_en: The 2027/28 auction held in December 2025, cleared at $333.44, at the price cap and 6.5GW short. So a 4.5GW leftwards shift in the demand curve is not sufficient to make a difference.

sentences.en: The 2027/28 auction held in December 2025, cleared at $333.44, at the price cap and 6.5GW short.
sentences.zh: 2027/28 年拍卖于 2025 年 12 月举行，成交价为 333.44 美元，按价格上限计算，缺口为 6.5GW。

sentences.en: So a 4.5GW leftwards shift in the demand curve is not sufficient to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 因此，需求曲线左移 4.5GW 不足以产生影响。

blocks.html_en: The 2028/29 auction held in July 2026, cleared at $325.00, at the cap and 6.8GW short. The 6.8GW target falls to about 3GW with improved modeling.

sentences.en: The 2028/29 auction held in July 2026, cleared at $325.00, at the cap and 6.8GW short.
sentences.zh: 2028/29 年拍卖于 2026 年 7 月举行，成交价为 325.00 美元，上限为 6.8GW。

sentences.en: The 6.8GW target falls to about 3GW with improved modeling.
sentences.zh: 随着模型的改进，6.8GW 的目标降至 3GW 左右。

blocks.html_en: That 6.8GW vs 3GW is now the billions-of-dollars question for PJM’s fast-approaching emergency auction.

sentences.en: That 6.8GW vs 3GW is now the billions-of-dollars question for PJM’s fast-approaching emergency auction.
sentences.zh: 6.8GW 与 3GW 现在是 PJM 即将进行的紧急拍卖中价值数十亿美元的问题。

blocks.html_en: Buying too much is bad in any auction, but this backstop auction has no defined counter-party. PJM plans to pay for power plants to get built on the expectation that energy demand arrives later. But if that demand does not arrive then PJM will still have to pay.

sentences.en: Buying too much is bad in any auction, but this backstop auction has no defined counter-party.
sentences.zh: 在任何拍卖中购买太多都是不好的，但这种支持拍卖没有明确的交易对手。

sentences.en: PJM plans to pay for power plants to get built on the expectation that energy demand arrives later.
sentences.zh: PJM 计划根据能源需求较晚到来的预期来支付建设发电厂的费用。

sentences.en: But if that demand does not arrive then PJM will still have to pay.
sentences.zh: 但如果这一需求没有到来，那么 PJM 仍然需要付费。

blocks.html_en: In theory new large loads are supposed to pay for this emergency auction. But the forcasted large loads are hypothetical and won’t be signing on the dotted line. The plan is for PJM to sign the contracts and for the States to each pass their own cost-allocation policy to allocate costs onto participating new large loads. PJM’s filing clarifies that “Because PJM does not have jurisdiction to allocate retail costs directly to individual data centers, state action will be essential.” This creates a lot of uncertainty for large loads as cost pass-on will be bespoke state-by-state.

sentences.en: In theory new large loads are supposed to pay for this emergency auction.
sentences.zh: 理论上，新的大量货物应该支付这次紧急拍卖的费用。

sentences.en: But the forcasted large loads are hypothetical and won’t be signing on the dotted line.
sentences.zh: 但预测的大量负载是假设的，不会在虚线上签名。

sentences.en: The plan is for PJM to sign the contracts and for the States to each pass their own cost-allocation policy to allocate costs onto participating new large loads.
sentences.zh: 该计划是由 PJM 签署合同，并让各州通过自己的成本分配政策，将成本分配给参与的新的大型负载。

sentences.en: PJM’s filing clarifies that “Because PJM does not have jurisdiction to allocate retail costs directly to individual data centers, state action will be essential.”
sentences.zh: PJM 的文件澄清说，“由于 PJM 无权将零售成本直接分配给各个数据中心，因此国家行动至关重要。”

sentences.en: This creates a lot of uncertainty for large loads as cost pass-on will be bespoke state-by-state.
sentences.zh: 这给大负荷带来了很多不确定性，因为成本转嫁将根据各州的情况进行定制。

blocks.html_en: Only new resources in service by June 2032 may bid. Contracts all end in 2043, so a power plant online in 2032 gets about eleven years. The costs are then assigned to transmission zones in proportion to forecast load growth between 2026/27 and 2028/29. Those shares are frozen for the full fifteen years. Inside each zone, a state will use bespoke policy design to direct the costs onward to specific large loads or distribution companies. If a state does nothing, the filing’s default applies and the costs fall on every load-serving entity in the zone by peak-load share.

sentences.en: Only new resources in service by June 2032 may bid.
sentences.zh: 只有 2032 年 6 月之前投入使用的新资源才可以投标。

sentences.en: Contracts all end in 2043, so a power plant online in 2032 gets about eleven years.
sentences.zh: 合同均于 2043 年到期，因此 2032 年上线的发电厂大约有 11 年的时间。

sentences.en: The costs are then assigned to transmission zones in proportion to forecast load growth between 2026/27 and 2028/29.
sentences.zh: 然后，成本将根据 2026/27 年至 2028/29 年预测负荷增长的比例分配给输电区域。

sentences.en: Those shares are frozen for the full fifteen years.
sentences.zh: 这些股份被冻结整整十五年。

sentences.en: Inside each zone, a state will use bespoke policy design to direct the costs onward to specific large loads or distribution companies.
sentences.zh: 在每个区域内，州政府将使用定制的政策设计将成本转嫁给特定的大型负载或配送公司。

sentences.en: If a state does nothing, the filing’s default applies and the costs fall on every load-serving entity in the zone by peak-load share.
sentences.zh: 如果某个州不采取任何行动，则适用该文件的默认规定，并且费用将按峰值负载分担由该区域内的每个负载服务实体承担。

blocks.html_en: There is no true-up, the zone shares are set by forecast growth and never revisited. The supply contracts are structured as guaranteed top-ups. Each winner is made whole to its bid against whatever the capacity market later pays out to 2043. Load-serving entities assigned backstop costs must post credit support of $1.5 million per megawatt of obligation, within ninety days of each delivery year. At the ceiling average of $555/MW-day the maximum liability for 6.8GW is roughly $21 billion.

sentences.en: There is no true-up, the zone shares are set by forecast growth and never revisited.
sentences.zh: 没有真实的上涨，区域份额由预测增长决定，并且从未重新审视。

sentences.en: The supply contracts are structured as guaranteed top-ups.
sentences.zh: 供应合同的结构是有保证的补充。

sentences.en: Each winner is made whole to its bid against whatever the capacity market later pays out to 2043.
sentences.zh: 每位获胜者都将获得完整的投标，无论容量市场随后支付到 2043 年的价格。

sentences.en: Load-serving entities assigned backstop costs must post credit support of $1.5 million per megawatt of obligation, within ninety days of each delivery year.
sentences.zh: 分配了支持成本的负载服务实体必须在每个交付年份的 90 天内提供每兆瓦义务 150 万美元的信贷支持。

sentences.en: At the ceiling average of $555/MW-day the maximum liability for 6.8GW is roughly $21 billion.
sentences.zh: 按照 555 美元/兆瓦/日的平均上限计算，6.8GW 的最大责任约为 210 亿美元。

blocks.html_en: There is no sweetener to encourage large loads to participate such as accelerated interconnection. There is not even assurance on ‘unaccelerated’ interconnection timelines. Then on the supply side there is little penalty for under-delivering once a plant is running. PJM itself projects that even with the backstop the next auction “may clear short”.

sentences.en: There is no sweetener to encourage large loads to participate such as accelerated interconnection.
sentences.zh: 没有任何甜头可以鼓励大负载参与，例如加速互连。

sentences.en: There is not even assurance on ‘unaccelerated’ interconnection timelines.
sentences.zh: 甚至无法保证“未加速”的互连时间表。

sentences.en: Then on the supply side there is little penalty for under-delivering once a plant is running.
sentences.zh: 然后，在供应方面，一旦工厂投入运行，交付不足几乎不会受到惩罚。

sentences.en: PJM itself projects that even with the backstop the next auction “may clear short”.
sentences.zh: PJM 本身预计，即使有支持，下一次拍卖“也可能会清空”。

blocks.html_en: Through PJM’s fast-track stakeholder process this spring, the members developed and endorsed a backstop design built around a voluntary subscription model. This was championed by a coalition of the electric distribution companies and the Data Center Coalition. The idea was for large new loads to subscribe first, committing to pay for the new capacity before it’s procured. Unbelievably for PJM that design won more than two-thirds sector-weighted support.

sentences.en: Through PJM’s fast-track stakeholder process this spring, the members developed and endorsed a backstop design built around a voluntary subscription model.
sentences.zh: 通过今年春天 PJM 的快速利益相关者流程，成员们开发并认可了围绕自愿订阅模式构建的支持设计。

sentences.en: This was championed by a coalition of the electric distribution companies and the Data Center Coalition.
sentences.zh: 这是由配电公司联盟和数据中心联盟倡导的。

sentences.en: The idea was for large new loads to subscribe first, committing to pay for the new capacity before it’s procured.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是让大量新负载首先订阅，承诺在采购新容量之前支付费用。

sentences.en: Unbelievably for PJM that design won more than two-thirds sector-weighted support.
sentences.zh: 对于 PJM 来说，令人难以置信的是，该设计赢得了超过三分之二的行业加权支持。

blocks.html_en: Then the Board overrode its own members. In its decisional letter of 27th July 2026, the Board rejected the subscription framework on the stated ground that it “would not provide sufficient assurance that capacity equal to the identified near-term shortfall would actually be procured”.

sentences.en: Then the Board overrode its own members.
sentences.zh: 然后董事会推翻了自己的成员。

sentences.en: In its decisional letter of 27th July 2026, the Board rejected the subscription framework on the stated ground that it “would not provide sufficient assurance that capacity equal to the identified near-term shortfall would actually be procured”.
sentences.zh: 在 2026 年 7 月 27 日的决定函中，董事会拒绝了认购框架，理由是该框架“无法充分保证实际采购的产能相当于已确定的近期缺口”。

blocks.html_en: That is why improving this system modeling is crucial. The Board decided this high-risk emergency auction was necessary because of modeling which overstates the near-term shortfall. The near-term shortfall is currently 6.8GW, recomputed it would be 3.0GW, an amount a subscription model could plausibly have covered. The total requirement of 156GW is built from the 2028/29 load forecast, which already embeds the anticipated datacenter growth.

sentences.en: That is why improving this system modeling is crucial.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么改进这个系统建模至关重要。

sentences.en: The Board decided this high-risk emergency auction was necessary because of modeling which overstates the near-term shortfall.
sentences.zh: 董事会认为这次高风险紧急拍卖是必要的，因为模型夸大了近期短缺。

sentences.en: The near-term shortfall is currently 6.8GW, recomputed it would be 3.0GW, an amount a subscription model could plausibly have covered.
sentences.zh: 目前近期的缺口为 6.8GW，重新计算后将为 3.0GW，订阅模式似乎可以覆盖这一数量。

sentences.en: The total requirement of 156GW is built from the 2028/29 load forecast, which already embeds the anticipated datacenter growth.
sentences.zh: 156GW 的总需求是根据 2028/29 年负载预测得出的，其中已经包含了预期的数据中心增长。

blocks.html_en: PJM has filed the Board’s proposal at FERC on 31st July 2026. The Board’s design uses a $555 average-cap and they added back a badly designed curtailment scheme (IRAS) that the members had rightly voted down. Both of these measures seem designed to dissuade new large loads from joining this scheme.

sentences.en: PJM has filed the Board’s proposal at FERC on 31st July 2026.
sentences.zh: PJM 已于 2026 年 7 月 31 日向 FERC 提交了董事会提案。

sentences.en: The Board’s design uses a $555 average-cap and they added back a badly designed curtailment scheme (IRAS) that the members had rightly voted down.
sentences.zh: 董事会的设计采用了 555 美元的平均上限，并且他们又增加了一个设计糟糕的限电计划 (IRAS)，而成员们正确地投票否决了该计划。

sentences.en: Both of these measures seem designed to dissuade new large loads from joining this scheme.
sentences.zh: 这两项措施似乎都是为了阻止新的大型负载加入该计划。

blocks.html_en: An average-price cap with pay-as-bid supply contracts means that participating demand loads do not know what price they will sign. The $555 cap constrains the portfolio average and not any individual contract. PJM’s own worked example shows a $600 offer clearing. The quantity being bought is also unknown, because the window for reporting bilateral offsets runs concurrently with the offer window. The load’s own share is unknown, because it depends on state allocation mechanisms that do not yet exist and on how many other loads participate. The average is applied at selection. If contracts are voided later, the remaining portfolio is never re-tested against $555. This risk is asymmetric on the upside as lower priced contracts are more likely to be abandoned or fail. Pay-as-bid makes this worse. In a marginal-price auction a bidder’s best strategy is to bid its true cost. Under pay-as-bid the best strategy is to bid your forecast of the highest accepted price. PJM’s own witness says this in the filing: pay-as-bid sellers “are more likely to offer the expected clearing price,” and market-power mitigation in this setting is “difficult and ineffective.”

blocks.html_en: Other than our reverse-engineered model almost none of this is new. In 2023 PJM proposed a full two-season capacity market itself. But after the Independent Market Monitor and others objected that the design needed more development time, PJM withdrew it and filed an annual-only package; FERC approved that package in January 2024 and declined to require seasonality. In September 2024, the Independent Market Monitor concluded that crediting the winter capability of thermal plants would have cut that year’s capacity bill by $2.7 billion with the reserve margin held fixed, and up to $8.0 billion otherwise. Its standing recommendation read: “There is no reason that excess winter CIRs cannot be assigned to these resources immediately.” In May 2025 PJM’s sensitivity analysis found the fleet’s winter capability runs 8,561 megawatts above its summer ratings. That same month, members voted 3.699 (of 5 sector-weighted votes) to defer adjacent transmission work “until such time that stakeholders undertake work on a seasonal capacity construct.” In July 2025 PJM’s own task force endorsed the fix in Package C. This included winter ratings and passed 178 votes to 54, 77%. Twenty-six days later, on 20th August 2025, the senior committee killed it with 30.7% of the weighted vote. Generation owners argued a higher winter rating raises the benchmark a plant is penalized against when it underperforms in summer. The consumer sectors voted PJM’s package down while backing two blunter alternatives, and the generators killed those in turn. In December 2025 E3 recommended seasonal or daily ratings, Consideration 4 of 14. No vote has been held since.

blocks.html_en: PJM’s centralized capacity market has fully failed at its core role of solving capacity shortfalls. Faced with the first instance of modest growth in its modern history, the capacity market was unable to procure capacity. Instead PJM’s design misallocated those dollars as windfall profits to existing generators while constraining supply with short lead times and long interconnection queues. PJM is making progress at creating a third energy market in the form of this emergency auction specifically for the new generation. But in doing so it is converting long-standing errors into long-standing liabilities with basic resource modeling accuracy still in the air.

content_html_zh:
今年早些时候，我们解释了为什么美国最大的电力市场 PJM 地区的居民电费上涨了约 20%。 我们认为罪魁祸首是 PJM 的拍卖设计选择以及 PJM 对需求和供应的建模方式。 为了更好地了解问题的严重程度，我们的能源模型团队在过去 6 个月里对 PJM 的主要系统模型“储备需求研究”进行了逆向工程，该模型迄今为止一直是一个黑匣子。 这项研究讲述了 PJM 如何通过年度拍卖并每年花费数十亿美元来决定购买哪种类型和多少个发电厂以确保电力可靠。

借助重建的模型，我们认为问题比我们想象的更严重。 PJM 的模型包含一些错误，我们估计仅在 2025 年至 2027 年间，其所有 6600 万居民就损失了总计 12B 美元。 我们在本新闻通讯的附件中为我们的订阅者分享了我们的方法；以及 PJM 模型仪表板中的模型结果。 我们实时重建的储备要求模型是一个专门为我们的能源模型客户提供的选项卡；其中还包括对整个美国电网的季度预测，跟踪超过 40,000 个并网发电厂以及每一个用户侧数据中心电力订单。

PJM 的模式在结构上是反增长的，其容量市场设计不佳且全球独一无二，治理体系太大而无法发挥作用。

这些缺陷放大了不良系统建模的负面影响，这是本报告的重点：

  1. PJM 低估了其现有发电厂约 4 吉瓦；由于这种方法没有考虑到冬季发电厂的更高效率以及自艾略特风暴以来发电厂恢复能力的提高。
  2. 由于这种薄弱的方法论，从 2025 年到 2027 年，PJM 浪费了约 120 亿美元的纳税人资金，极大地夸大了其面临的供需缺口。 如果 PJM 的模型准确的话，家庭电费上涨幅度会小得多。
  3. PJM 的紧急拍卖在没有承诺交易对手的情况下签署了过多电力的合同，从而使纳税人面临风险。

使用 PJM 的需求和供应曲线，我们计算出更好的建模将节省 6.7B 美元，而 2025/26 年采购的电力仅减少 0.014GW（是的，14MW）；然后 2026/27 年为 4.9B 美元和 0.8GW。 更多的电力意味着更少的节省可能是违反直觉的，但我们有供给和需求曲线来显示这些不成比例的影响是如何发生的。 PJM 迫使自己在极限状态下运行，因此不准确的发电厂容量建模会对拍卖成本产生巨大影响。

PJM 的一年期合同在签署后就开始得太早，而且这些新电厂并网的速度很慢，从而限制了自己的新电力供应。 这意味着满足任何需求增长都需要为以不切实际的速度建造新发电厂支付巨额溢价。 PJM 还运营着世界上唯一不区分新发电厂和现有发电厂的容量市场。 因此，为新发电厂支付的溢价也被支付给无所事事的现有发电厂。 将新电厂和现有电厂拍卖分开的市场的相同增长避免了对整个机组重新定价的数量效应；这意味着纳税人可以更好地免受价格上涨的影响。

尽管四次破纪录的拍卖花费了 $63B，但 PJM 将缺乏可靠运行所需的发电量，并计划从 9 月 30 日至 10 月 21 日进行“紧急拍卖”，并在 12 月 2 日之前得出结果。 SemiAnalysis 得出的结论是，考虑到冷空气带来的涡轮机效率提高以及联邦强制资产防冻投资后冬季故障风险的降低，PJM 系统上额外提供了 3.8GW 的可靠电力。 这相当于今天建造八座大型天然气发电厂的成本约为 100 亿美元。 这 3.8GW 将抵消 PJM 计划在紧急拍卖中采购的 6.8GW 的 56%。

PJM 的紧急拍卖存在严重风险，它将签署有效期至 2043 年的合同，这些合同应该由新的大批量货物支付。 这些不是电力销售；而是电力销售。无论预测需求是否到来，工厂仅根据现有设备获得报酬。 但 PJM 在没有承诺的交易对手的情况下这样做。 PJM没有自己的钱，所有花的钱都来自纳税人。

每个 PJM 州都必须通过（但尚未这样做）自己的成本分配政策，以将成本转嫁给参与新的大型负载。 但如果这些大型负荷直接承包自己的额外发电厂，则可以选择退出。 如果他们参与，则很难清楚他们预计将支付多少拍卖费用。 参与不会带来其他好处，例如加速互连时间表。 不管怎样，许多数据中心开发人员已经放弃了 PJM，转向其他地方或规划电表后面的电源配置。 如果没有其他交易对手出现，那么剩下的承担者将再次是住宅纳税人。

在本报告中，我们深入研究了 PJM 的容量市场并介绍了我们专有的逆向工程模型。 我们认为，PJM 未能准确地模拟两个关键的供应特征，尽管主要利益相关者认识到它们既真实又重要：

  1. PJM 并不相信寒冷、稠密的空气如何使天然气发电厂在冬季发电能力提高高达 25%；和
  2. PJM 的风险计算尚未更新，以认识到早在 2024 年，PJM 约 700 座天然气工厂中的 400 座就已投资于冬季可靠性措施，以应对艾略特风暴造成的停电。

PJM 存在比模特更深层的问题。 目前的拍卖是二十年前设计的，自那以后需求就没有增长。 如今，PJM 在结构上是反增长的。 由于治理僵局和既得利益者的否决，PJM 未能适应负荷增长的新时代。 如果无法实现市场改革，也许可以通过改进容量模型来阻止纳税人流血，尤其是在冬季即将到来的时候。

本报告将深入挖掘 PJM 的产能市场。 在提供一些介绍性背景后，我们采用以下结构：

  • 我们从基本原理开始，解释 PJM 如何对供应、需求和可靠性风险进行建模。 我们介绍了他们在 2024 年从 EFORd 到储备金要求研究的主要建模方法变化以及该变化的影响。
  • 我们介绍了我们的逆向工程模型，并更深入地介绍了我们如何计算各种资源、中断、可靠性和机队规模的作用。
  • 我们谈到了核心问题：PJM 没有考虑到冬季燃气发电厂吞吐量的增加，以及通过资产冬季化提高可靠性的问题。
  • 然后我们深入研究定价影响。 PJM 的容量拍卖非常复杂，我们解释了 PJM 6600 万居民的电费为何以及如何比实际需要的高出 $12B。
  • 最后，我们对 PJM 的未来及其即将举行的可靠性支持拍卖提供了一些想法。 这是一种紧急机制，希望数据中心能够为自己的容量付费。 我们认为纳税人可能再次面临风险。
